notes.title: Steam Playtest - Patch Notes 0.2.5α
notes.notes: [p]What's up, players? Crit Team dropping in! Sorry about the long wait. We've had too much on our plate over the past two months. But thank goodness, we've now finally broken free from those chores, phew! With that, we bring you the [b]0.2.5α[/b] update. This marks the start of another long-term maintenance. We'll be pushing forward with subsequent updates as soon as possible to refine the game's overall framework. Fingers crossed you dig it.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]System[/b][/h3][p]Different search points now have distinct SFX/background panels.[/p][p]Shelf-type search points now visually reflect loot richness.[/p][p]Suppressor-type muzzle attachments now modify gunfire sounds.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dual Crosshair Aiming[/b][/h3][p]We noticed players occasionally lost track of their aim position while using auto-aim, resulting in missed tracking. The new dual crosshair system addresses this by locking the internal aim to targets and continuously showing the player's actual cursor position externally.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Map[/b][/h3][p][b]\[Origin-00-1963] Burning Grove[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Players must complete a series of linear missions to unlock this new map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Abnormal Status[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Burned[/b]: Causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire Field[/b]: You are in a fire field, affected by smoke and heat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoke[/b]: Accelerates stamina cost and causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scorch[/b]: Causes continuous damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Filtered Air[/b]: Safeguards your respiratory system from environmental hazards but increases stamina cost[/p][/*][*][p][b]High Heat Protection[/b]: Insulates you from high temperatures, enabling uninterrupted operation in extreme heat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Echostrider[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pyromad[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dimenshift Butterfly[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Enemy[/b]: Eerie Puppet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Enemy[/b]: Arson Doctor[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]新装备[/b][/h3][p]RS Private 41 35rd Magazine[/p][p]RS Private 43[/p][list][*][p]RS Private 43 35rd Magazine[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran 43 Folding Stock[/p][/*][/list][p]RS Veteran M[/p][list][*][p]RS Veteran M Solid Wood Grip[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M Solid Wood Stock[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M Barrel[/p][/*][*][p]RS Veteran M 30rd Magazine[/p][/*][/list][p]RS M1891[/p][list][*][p]RS 3.5x PE Sight[/p][/*][*][p]RS M1891 Standard Bolt[/p][/*][/list][p]SVG Lion M90 Master Red Dot G[/p][p]Wolff SnapPoint 6x Long Arm Scope G[/p][p]Hardened Chitin Dagger[/p][p]Fishbone Sickle[/p][p]Biomaterial Gas Mask[/p][p]PTN Heat Resistant Suit[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Items[/b][/h3][p]PVC Tape[/p][p]Fungus-Tuned Bio-Frequency Meter[/p][p]Reverse Mote[/p][p]"Purging Fire" Operation Plan[/p][p]Key to Laboratory - Equipment Storage Room[/p][p][i]Some crafting recipes have also been added.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2][p]Updated the sprite of RS Veteran 47 and its attachments.[/p][p]Balanced the defense of T-Shirt (Black): [b]3 → 1[/b].[/p][p]Added a key-unlockable room to the Laboratory of \[Origin-00-1961] Forest Region.[/p][p]Changed terrain shape and collision.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/99abef500327c743d1de13ea7d43e083a1994cd1.png"][/img][/p][p]Increased default value for mini-map's height-based shading to better highlight impassable terrain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/47206e1e2af74d10aa91aec787663599ba382f6f.png"][/img]Optimized stage selection screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/d5b5f5e45574e8e6e871676b71314349cf3dfeba.gif"][/img][/p][p]Improved perspective effect.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/361cc322dbce3db93fce122e8120aa6cf141fdf1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302058/8d12c940c6d77de6be3e18c882026be4459613a5.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Hit effects are now triggered via server notification instead of client-side, providing clearer hit feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a duplicated English localization string.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several errors in English localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing localization texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Attempted to fix an invisible wall near the valley.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a cursor display issue on the U.R.C. terminal screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Gunsmith issue on the transmitter panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where shooting could result in negative XP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing models in some search points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing wall in the safehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a confusing guide instruction in the new player tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the furious status of Scary Highlander was lost. Mycomarked will now enrage Scary Highlander and enhance their abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: We know this update lacks substantial new content. Our upcoming development focus will revolve around content expansion.[/i][/p]
